# Description

Follow-up to #4461. Applies the same `ensure`-based cleanup pattern to every other spec that has inline `restore_items_from_backup` calls inside `it` blocks.

## Why

`Avo::Resources::*.with_temporary_items` stores the given block on the class as `temporary_items`. `lib/avo/resources/base.rb#detect_fields` then `instance_eval`s that block on every subsequent `detect_fields` call until `restore_items_from_backup` is called. If a test fails before its trailing `restore_items_from_backup`, the block leaks into following tests, replacing their default field set and producing cascading, hard-to-debug failures.

## Audit

Every spec file calling `with_temporary_items` / `restore_items_from_backup` was checked. Three categories:

| Category | Action |
|----------|--------|
| **A** — restore is already in `before`/`after`/`around` hooks | No change |
| **B** — `restore_items_from_backup` is the trailing line of an `it` block | Move into `ensure` |
| **C** — intentional inter-test leak (e.g. the `format_using` describe in `tags_spec.rb`) | No change |

Files left untouched (Category A): `default_sort_column_and_direction_spec.rb`, `has_field_discovery_spec.rb`, `date_time_western_spec.rb`, `fields_view_type_spec.rb`, `tabs_panels_and_sidebar_visibility_spec.rb`, `default_field_spec.rb`, `boolean_field_spec.rb`, `time_spec.rb`, `sti_person_spouse_spec.rb`, `stars_field_spec.rb`, `date_time_eastern_spec.rb`, `select_field_spec.rb`, `date_time_utc_spec.rb`, `date_time_spec.rb`, `timezone_spec.rb`.

Files changed (Category B), 5 files / 11 tests:
- `spec/features/avo/has_many_field_spec.rb` — 2 tests
- `spec/features/avo/number_spec.rb` — 5 tests
- `spec/system/avo/create_via_belongs_to_spec.rb` — 1 test
- `spec/system/avo/tabs_spec.rb` — 1 test
- `spec/system/avo/trix_field_spec.rb` — 3 tests

Additionally, one file was missing the `restore_items_from_backup` call entirely (a clear pre-existing bug — the leaked items would persist for the rest of the suite):
- `spec/features/avo/search_has_many_scope_spec.rb` — 1 test, added `ensure restore_items_from_backup`

## Open question: should `with_temporary_items` itself be scope-bound?

The mechanical `ensure` pattern works but duplicates the same boilerplate at every call site. The root cause is that `with_temporary_items` is not actually scope-bound — it just sets class state and forgets. The block it takes is the items definition (later `instance_eval`'d in `detect_fields`), not a scope block.

A cleaner API would let callers write:

```ruby
Avo::Resources::Project.with_temporary_items(-> {
  field :stage, as: :tags, mode: :select
}) do
  visit avo.resources_projects_path
  expect(page).to have_text(\"activity_category2\")
end
# items automatically restored, even on failure
```

Implementation sketch in `lib/avo/concerns/can_replace_items.rb`:

```ruby
def with_temporary_items(items_proc = nil, &block)
  if items_proc.nil?
    # Legacy: block is the items definition, no scope.
    self.temporary_items = block
  else
    # New: positional items proc + scope block.
    self.temporary_items = items_proc
    yield
  end
ensure
  self.temporary_items = nil if items_proc
end
```

Or alternatively, introduce a separate method (e.g. `using_temporary_items`) to avoid the dual-mode API.

This would eliminate ~20 `ensure ... restore_items_from_backup` boilerplate calls across the suite. **Happy to send a follow-up PR doing the migration if you're open to it** — let me know which API shape you prefer (overload on `with_temporary_items`, new method name, or something else).

# Checklist:

- [x] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [x] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the [documentation](https://github.com/avo-hq/avodocs)
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works

## Screenshots & recording

N/A — test-only change.

## Manual review steps

1. Run the affected specs:
   ```
   bundle exec rspec \\
     spec/features/avo/has_many_field_spec.rb \\
     spec/features/avo/number_spec.rb \\
     spec/features/avo/search_has_many_scope_spec.rb \\
     spec/system/avo/create_via_belongs_to_spec.rb \\
     spec/system/avo/tabs_spec.rb \\
     spec/system/avo/trix_field_spec.rb
   ```
2. Optional: deliberately make one of the affected tests fail mid-body (e.g. add `expect(true).to be false` after `with_temporary_items`). Before this change, the class-level `temporary_items` would leak; with this change, it is cleared after the failure.
title: chore: ensure remaining specs restore resource items on failure
